item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for ECG Connector and Cable Assemblies
item.description:
11P Clamshell ECG Connector with Cable Assembly
#

The 11P Clamshell ECG connector with cable assembly is designed to meet the demanding requirements of medical applications. This solution combines precision plastic injection components with reliable cable assembly, ensuring both durability and performance in clinical environments.

item.title: Precision in Medical Cable Assemblies and Plastic Injection Components
item.description:
Precision in Medical Cable Assemblies and Plastic Injection Components
#

Cambus specializes in the meticulous design and assembly of custom plastic injection components, with a particular focus on medical cable assemblies such as the Dual Invasive Blood Pressure (IBP) Cable Assembly. Our approach is rooted in attention to detail and a commitment to delivering solutions that meet the specific needs of our clients in the medical sector.

item.title: Expertise in Custom Medical Cable Assemblies and Precision Plastic Components
item.description:
Comprehensive Capabilities in Medical Cable Assemblies and Plastic Components
#

Cambus Corporation has been dedicated to providing engineering and manufacturing solutions for custom medical cable assemblies and plastic components since 1997. Our expertise encompasses a wide range of services, from OEM/ODM design to precision plastic injection molding, cable assembly, and wire harness solutions tailored for the medical industry and beyond.
